packageRules.description: Never pin this repository's own action. test-release.yaml exists to verify what a consumer referencing 'releasetools/cli@v0' actually gets, and git::release --major force-moves the v0 tag onto every release. A digest pin would freeze the self-test to the previous release's action code and its baked-in action.yml default version, so the job would validate the previous release while reporting success for the new one.
